BiblicalUsage: Joshbekashah is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 25:4; 1 Chronicles 25:24. In 1 Chronicles 25:4 we read, "Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti..." It appears again in 1 Chronicles 25:24: "The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:"
TheologicalSignificance: Joshbekashah is written down once, and I take that as proof God counts individuals. God kept the name, and that tells me he kept the person.
